description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Infers a JSON Schema (2020-12) from 1-1,000 sample documents: types with null and integer vs number, properties, required (keys present in every sample), array items, string formats (date-time, date, email, uri, uuid, ipv4, ipv6) when every value matches, optional enums and strict mode. Input: json (one document or an array of samples; POST for large input), optional samples, enums, strict. Limits: 1 MB, depth 64. Pair with json-validate. Offline.

enums.description: yes: add enum for string fields with at most 10 distinct values, each seen at least twice (default no)

json.description: JSON text, up to 1 MB (a JSON value is also accepted in a POST body or MCP arguments)

samples.description: auto (default): a top-level array of objects is a list of samples; yes: the top-level array is a list of samples; no: the whole input is one sample

strict.description: yes: additionalProperties false on every object (default no)

name: json_schema_infer
title: JSON Schema 2020-12 inferred from sample JSON
